caption:
Gas is the big reason inflation jumped last month. ⛽

BLS says gasoline prices rose 9.1% in September alone and are up 34.2% over the past year.

Meanwhile food prices were up just 2.5% over the year.

How much more are you spending on gas or commuting than last year?
